chunks: Those who are oblivious of their prayer.
ai.seo_question: What does it mean to be 'sahoon' (negligent) regarding prayer in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah Al-Ma'un is often interpreted to denote not merely the omission of prayer, but a state of spiritual negligence and lack of khushu' (presence of heart) even when praying. It serves as a critique of those who perform rituals mechanically while remaining disconnected from the divine reality, a theme emphasized by scholars like Allamah Tabatabai in 'Al-Mizan'. This heedlessness is viewed as a precursor to broader moral decay and hypocrisy, distinguishing them from the truly faithful.
